paper-faint.$description: Used at 11-14px for eyebrows and metadata, which is below the large-text threshold, so it needs 4.5:1. 5.95:1 on the page ground.

out-dim.$description: Darker than --color-out, not lighter. "Dim" is used for the recessive half of a two-tone pair (the fixed band in a stacked bar, an unfilled track), so inverting the relationship makes those read backwards.

out-lift.$description: The cost-mix chart stacks fixed under variable. Both used to be outflow tones one step apart, which was legible when outflow was orange and is not now that it is blue — this is the light end of the same hue, far enough above --color-out to read as a separate band.

edited.$description: Reserved for human edits. Never use for anything else.

flow-required.$description: The Sankey's four buckets. A single "outflow" colour was enough when outflow was orange against a green inflow; in an all-cool palette every ribbon collapses into the same blue. These alternate light/dark down the stack so adjacent ribbons always separate by lightness, and differ in hue for the pairs that never touch. tests/design-tokens.test.ts pins both.
